goal: Deliver structured log entries directly to bitcoinkernel consumers instead of formatted strings
Spare downstream users from brittle string parsing to extract log metadata
Decouple the kernel library from node-specific logging machinery like buffering and filtering
reviewability: A recent push addressed docstring updates and cleanup callback ordering on failure
agreement: Strong support for rationalizing the kernel logging API and avoiding dispatcher indirection (ryanofsky)
Approval without stated reasons after earlier resource leak fixes (w0xlt)
Answered objection: singletons introduce viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)
Addressed objections on global initialization logging and callback lifetime (ajtowns, musaHaruna)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because downstream library consumers no longer need to parse formatted strings to extract metadata
Removes node-oriented logging mechanisms like pre-connection buffering from the kernel library
